images.caption: Figure 15:Agent-written triangulation ininsert_tubes.Matching pixels marked A define viewing rays, illustrated schematically above the executed code excerpt. Recorded coordinates and reprojection errors connect the calculation to its output; the final frame follows subsequent grasping and insertion.

Figure 16:Geometric hypothesis testing incover_blocks.The agent varies a candidate table height and computes cup dimensions from selected pixels. The schematic illustrates the ray–plane intersections computed byhit()in the code excerpt; the right-hand frame shows a later placement over the red block.

Figure 17:Grasp adjustment and supported sliding inalign_blocks.The upper row summarizes four stages, each illustrated by a representative observation; a stage may contain multiple tool calls. Green and blue bars show physical tools and model requests; shading marks overlap. The marked interval is enlarged below, where the model prepares a clearance check during release. Image timestamps and the main axis are relative to the first displayed observation.

Figure 18:Orientation preparation during digit transport.The upper row summarizes four stages rather than individual tool calls; the lanes below show recorded execution. The enlarged interval shows a model request preparing rotation candidates while transport continues. The later divergence is retained to show how execution feedback affects the prepared plan. Colors and time conventions match Figure17.
